text: THE FRAME WINS, TWICE, ON FRAMES NO FINDING IN THE CORPUS HAS CITED. Three stills from the same longplay settle REBUILD_READINESS.md:158 without any code. (1) reference/frames/combat_frames/Nr4fQstqHDM_t0435s.png, crop (150,930)-(620,1080) of 1920x1080 at 3x LANCZOS: green HP 19/20, blue Chi 26/26, and the third bar roughly 42% filled with a WHITE block - with NO 'CANNOT CHANGE STANCE' caption anywhere, the yellow '150% DAMAGE' buff still below the stack, screen flashed red from a hit just taken. (2) _t0430s.png, same crop: HP 20/20, Chi 26/26, a thin white sliver at the left end of the third bar, caption again ABSENT. (3) reference/frames/duel_dense/Nr4fQstqHDM_429.0.png, crop (0,920)-(620,1080) at 3x: same fight, third bar EMPTY, caption ON. That is §1t113s0§.as:336-343 (show at ratio==0) and :344-347 (hide while 0<ratio<1) rendered on film, and a caption that comes and goes inside one battle cannot be 'appears the instant a fight starts'. SECOND, UNCLAIMED RESULT: _t0425s.png, same crop, is the OVERWORLD HUD and has NO third bar at all - the slot under HP and Chi prints the words 'HEAVY STANCE' instead, and the 150% DAMAGE banner is absent. So the Focus/reload bar is a BATTLE-ONLY HUD element and the overworld reuses that slot as a stance-name readout. Every banked frame finding on this cluster cites duel_dense 428.0/432.5/432.9 or session11/crit-focus; 'combat_frames' appears exactly once in LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md and not for this, and 't0435' and 'HEAVY STANCE' appear zero times.

text: The 'Critical Evade' skill card that a banked A1 finding read off film has a web-side code twin nobody has cited, and it shows the full-Focus state gating evasion and crit SIMULTANEOUSLY - so the card and the crit multiplier were never in conflict. §1t99s0§.as:3383-3388, inside the hit-resolution override §1t3274s0§ (opens :3328), reads: 'if(this.§1t4465s0§() && this.§1t4414s0§ == this.§1t4415s0§ && (this.stance == §1t12220s0§ && this.§1t4491s0§(§1t120s0§.§1t10173s0§) > 0 || this.stance == §1t12221s0§ && ...§1t10174s0§ > 0 || this.stance == §1t12222s0§ && ...§1t10175s0§ > 0))' then sets §1t3246s0§ = 12, plays 'Snd_jump' and RETURNS TRUE - i.e. the incoming hit is consumed with no damage applied. A second identical branch sits at :3707. Three separate passives, one per core stance, each a skill the player must own (§1t4491s0§(...) > 0 is a skill-level lookup), all keyed on reload == maxreload. Meanwhile :3272-3274 applies the x1.3 crit on the same predicate. LEDGER_EVIDENCE.md contains zero hits for '3383', '10173' or '4491s0'.

quote: §1t99s0§.as:3272 'if(this.§1t4414s0§ == this.§1t4415s0§)' ‖ android MCSPlayer.as:3215 'if(this.reload == this.maxreload)' · :3219 'return maxDamage * 1.2 + this.STAT_CRITICALDMG;' · :3221 'return maxDamage * 1.5 + this.STAT_CRITICALDMG;'
text: RR:195 blocker (5) files the crit PROC rule as 'chance vs deterministic — entirely absent'. It is deterministic, and there is no dice roll anywhere near it. Web §1t99s0§.as:3272, inside the damage roll §1t4475s0§ (:3255), is 'if(this.§1t4414s0§ == this.§1t4415s0§)' -> ':3274 return _loc2_ * 1.3 + this.§1t1243s0§;'. Those two members are reload and maxreload: the android twin getDamage (MCSPlayer.as:3198) has the same test in plain English at :3215 'if(this.reload == this.maxreload)'. Crit fires exactly when the Focus meter is FULL, every time, and §1t99s0§.as:3295-3297 zeroes the meter on the next swing, so a full bar buys exactly one crit. SEPARATE HAZARD, and it is a build-parity trap: the MULTIPLIER is web-only. Android MCSPlayer.as:3219 returns 'maxDamage * 1.2 + this.STAT_CRITICALDMG' for non-Light stances and :3221 'maxDamage * 1.5 + ...' for Light. Anyone reading crit out of the android blobs gets 1.2/1.5, not 1.3 — and the wiki's 1.3 happens to match the WEB build only.

The stance setter §1t3489s0§ (§1t99s0§.as:3083) ends with 'if(§1t1525s0§.§1t9948s0§()) { this.§1t4414s0§ -= 48; if(this.§1t4414s0§ < 0) { this.§1t4414s0§ = 0; } ... §1t5205s0§(reload, maxreload); }' at :3160-3170. The android twin names the guard — MCSPlayer.as:3096 'if(StageManager.isBattle())' — and charges a DIFFERENT price: :3098-3105 'if(this.reload > this.maxreload / 2) { this.reload = this.maxreload / 3; } else { this.reload -= this.maxreload / 6; }'. Combined with the entry gate at §1t99s0§.as:3060 'if(this.§1t4414s0§ < 48) { return; }', the v0.717 rule is: you may cycle stance in combat iff Focus >= 48, and doing so spends exactly 48.
